muscle_role.definition: Working roles are prime_mover, synergist, and stabilizer. Predicted top 5 are those roles ordered by prime, then synergist, then stabilizer, then by descending emission score. overlap = |predicted top 5 ∩ reference working set| / min(5, |reference working set|). A predicted prime mover fails the sign check when its frozen action-table sign disagrees with the claimed task moment on a task coordinate, or when it agrees with none.
